title: When the Alibi Sings
author: Lena Vasquez
blurb: Sebastian Nakamura, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
